cad.title: PCB Enclosure
cad.subtitle: Custom-fit enclosure design for a PCB assembly
cad.description: A snap-fit enclosure designed around a specific PCB's mounting holes, connectors and component heights, built for FDM 3D printing.
cad.problem: Off-the-shelf enclosures rarely line up with a custom PCB's mounting holes, port cutouts and component clearances, leading to a messy final assembly.
cad.solution: Modelled the enclosure directly around the PCB's outline, standoffs and connector positions, with wall thickness and snap-fit tabs sized for reliable FDM 3D printing.
